'''Bionic Lure''' is a consumable.

==Summary==
'''Bionic Lure''' is a [[Fishing Bait]] that can be crafted by the player and used with [[Fishing Rig]] or [[Lost Angler's Rig]].

==Game Description==
A piece of specialist bait, designed to improve the size and rarity of your catch.

Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with {{ButtonPerformInteraction}}.

==Source==
{{Craft|Amino Chamber,2;Ion Battery,3;Lubricant,3;20|blueprint=no}}

==Usage==
Select your fishing/angler's rig from your [[Multi-tool]] inventory, press {{ButtonPerformInteraction}} to access your [[Fishing#Bait_Box|Bait Box]] and then select the fishing bait to apply it to your rig.

This will apply a bonus when catching your next fish. When a fish is caught, or the line is reeled in, you will lose one piece of [[bait]] from your rig.
